## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set; second model and all five similar cases agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Sharply peaked |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 | No input warning |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Concordant |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 5, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; strongest concept association [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score; failed AI spot check, 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable
- **Scarce benign stroma or fat** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Low amount counts toward invasive in concept model [F4] · Validated
- **Few gland/tubule structures** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Low tubule score; caption check inconsistent · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitotic figures are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Image is a JPEG-degraded simulated frozen section; reliability ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Mitotic score failed its spot check yet carries the second-largest concept weight.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4, 9:** Look for true mitoses; this concept failed its spot check.
2. **Regions 3, 5, 10:** Confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11:** Confirm tumor reaches the cut edge; suggested call is tumor at all four margins.
